protocol.title: A Versatile Microfluidic Device for Automating Synthetic Biology
protocol.objective: On-chip Golden Gate, Gibson, and Yeast (TAR cloning) DNA assembly with integrated region-specific temperature control and on-chip electroporation transformation; 16 combinatorial plasmid variants (4 Promoter x 4 BCD) per assembly method

functional_regions: Queuing and incubation region (serpentine PDMS channel, 1.5 mm wide, stores 16 droplets)

fabrication.photolithography: S1811 photoresist, OAI Series 200 Aligner, UV 40 mW/cm2 5s
fabrication.etching: Gold etchant KI/I2; chromium etchant CR-4

reagents.surfactant_additive: Pluronic F-127 0.05% w/v (prevents biofouling; replaces wash steps)

dna_assembly.preparation: DpnI digested at 37 C 1h; BsaI digested overnight 37 C (Golden Gate only); gel purified
dna_assembly.vector_concentration_matching: Vacuum concentrator Thermo Fisher, 65 C, 5-10 min

golden_gate.ligase: T4 DNA ligase 2.5 U/uL with 0.05% w/v Pluronic F-127

yeast.notes: No additional reagents required; assembly occurs in vivo after transformation

electroporation.ecoli_media: 8 mM Na2HPO4, 2 mM KH2PO4, 250 mM sucrose pH 7.4

plasmid_variants.vector_golden_gate_gibson: p15A origin + kanamycin resistance (~2100 bp backbone)
plasmid_variants.vector_yeast: pRS424 (2 micron origin + TRP1 marker for yeast; F1 origin + ampicillin for bacteria; ~5600 bp)

steps.name: Oil phase priming
steps.notes: 1 mL HFE 7500 + 0.05% w/v Pluronic F-127 pipetted onto DMF surface. Oil surrounds all aqueous droplets throughout the protocol, preventing cross-contamination without wash steps. First application of this strategy to on-chip DNA assembly.

steps.name: Dispense vector backbone
steps.notes: pFAB4876-based vector backbone; BsaI + DpnI digested, gel-purified; ~2100 bp (Golden Gate). Reservoir refilled via SU-8 capillary channel between successive reactions.

steps.name: Dispense Promoter1 insert
steps.notes: Representative variant: Promoter1 from pFAB4876; ~100 bp band. Four promoter variants (Prom1, Prom2, Prom9, Prom11) used across 16 combinatorial reactions; this .bs file encodes Prom1.

steps.name: Dispense BCD1-gfp insert
steps.notes: Representative variant: BCD1_gfp from pFAB4876; ~800 bp band. Four BCD variants (BCD1, BCD2, BCD20, BCD21) used across 16 reactions. GFP enables colony color screening: green = correct insert, white = self-ligation artifact.

steps.name: Dispense T4 DNA ligase
steps.notes: T4 ligase reservoir maintained at room temperature while incubation zone is heated (region-specific Peltier). Prevents heat inactivation above 50 C. Gibson assembly uses 2x Gibson master mix instead; Yeast assembly requires no additional reagent.

steps.name: Mix vector backbone with Promoter1
steps.notes: All droplet actuation on DMF region uses 8 kHz sine wave amplified to ~100-120 V rms. Volumetric precision ~1.5% variation (impedance feedback).

steps.name: Add BCD1-gfp to DNA mix
steps.notes: Three-component droplet: vector + Promoter1 + BCD1-gfp. Total volume ~0.6 uL at this stage.

steps.name: Add T4 DNA ligase to complete Golden Gate mix
steps.notes: Final assembled droplet: vector + Promoter1 + BCD1-gfp + T4 ligase. Mixed 2-3 times in circular fashion. Paper Table 1: total volume 0.8 uL, 2 DNA fragment insertions, room temperature Golden Gate.

steps.name: Digital-to-droplet transfer and Golden Gate incubation
steps.transfer_mechanism: Syringe-vacuum pump at 0.1 uL/s draws droplet from DMF into channel; oil phase HFE 7500 at 5 uL/s drives droplet to incubation zone
steps.peltier: Region-specific; incubation zone maintained at 25 C (room temperature); reservoirs unheated
steps.notes: Golden Gate: 25 C, 10 min. BsaI-HF creates 4-bp overhangs; T4 ligase joins complementary ends. Gibson alternative: 50 C, 15 min with 2x Gibson master mix. Yeast alternative: 25 C, 10 min, no ligase (assembly occurs in vivo post-transformation).

steps.name: Assembly QC detection
steps.notes: assemblyQC abstracts the GFP colony color screening step performed after electroporation and plating (off-chip). On-chip, no direct assembly verification precedes transformation; detect gate here models the logical QC branch. Expected pass rate: ~95% correct clones for Golden Gate (76/80 sequenced, Fig 6); ~100% for Gibson (80/80).

steps.name: Assembly QC gate - pass branch
steps.notes: Golden Gate ligation succeeded; assembled plasmid disposed (QC characterisation run). Proceed to transformation branch via BB4.

steps.name: Assembly QC gate - fail branch
steps.notes: Ligation failed (e.g. self-ligation dominant, white colonies). Drain assembled droplet. Compiler known bug: drain lowered to dispose in IR; biological intent is drain.

steps.name: Dispose assembly QC signal
steps.notes: Assembly join block. Transformation branch begins.

steps.name: Dispense competent E. coli cells
steps.dispensing_electrodes: Three 1.4 x 0.7 mm + one 4.0 x 0.7 mm at cell-inlet/channel intersection
steps.notes: Cells dispensed from cell inlet into electroporation region. Elastomeric microvalve (valve 5, Fig S2) prevents cross-contamination between successive plasmid droplets. For yeast assembly: CEN.PK cells in 1.0 M sorbitol instead.

steps.name: Dispense incubated plasmid (channel exit)
steps.notes: Models the assembled pProm1_BCD1-gfp droplet exiting the serpentine incubation channel and entering the electroporation zone, driven by HFE 7500 at 5 uL/s with all valves closed (Fig S2). BioScript ownership constraint: assemblyMix was consumed by detect(assemblyQC) in BB1; incubatedPlasmid is a distinct fluid object representing the same physical droplet at its new location in the CFG.

steps.name: Mix cells with electroporation media
steps.media_composition: 8 mM Na2HPO4, 2 mM KH2PO4, 250 mM sucrose pH 7.4
steps.notes: Osmotically balanced electroporation buffer prevents cell lysis during pulse. Cells fully resuspended in EP media before merging with plasmid droplet.

steps.name: Merge incubated plasmid with cell mix
steps.notes: Merged droplet positioned over two bare gold electroporation microelectrodes (2.0 x 0.3 mm, 100 um gap, no dielectric coating). Contains assembled + non-assembled DNA fragments and cells.

steps.name: Electroporation

pulse_parameters.detection: Impedance-sensing feedback; Vsense threshold ~0.15 V; oil phase (no droplet) impedance > 10 GOhm; droplet impedance 0.1-10 MOhm

steps.notes: heat at 37 C models post-pulse recovery temperature; pulse itself is instantaneous. Oil phase (HFE 7500) prevents electrical short when no droplet bridges electrode gap. Microfluidic efficiency not significantly different from cuvette (Fig 5a). Yeast: 1200 V/cm, 1.90e3 CFU/ng (Fig 5b).

steps.name: Post-electroporation recovery
steps.notes: Electroporated droplet driven to outlet by HFE 7500 oil (all valves closed). Collected in tube containing 200 uL LB broth. 1 h outgrowth at 37 C before plating. ~100/110 colonies green (GFP+, correct insert); ~10 white (self-ligation). Plated on LB agar + kanamycin 50 ug/mL.

steps.name: Transformation QC detection
steps.notes: transformationQC abstracts off-chip colony counting on kanamycin LB-agar plates (37 C overnight). Colony-PCR and Sanger sequencing (primers QB3284_fwd / QB3810_rev; QuintaraBio) confirm assembly. Golden Gate: 95% correct (76/80). Gibson: 100% (80/80). Yeast: 97.2% (70/72).

steps.name: Transformation QC gate - pass branch
steps.notes: Transformed colonies confirmed; dispose recovery droplet.

steps.name: Transformation QC gate - fail branch
steps.notes: No viable transformed cells detected (electroporation failure or no assembly). Drain recovery droplet. Compiler known bug: drain lowered to dispose in IR.

steps.name: Final cleanup
steps.notes: Dispose transformation QC signal and oil phase droplet. Terminal block. In the actual protocol, Steps S1-S19 are repeated 15 more times (16 total iterations) using the same electrode path, mixing channel, and incubation channel. Reservoir droplets refilled via SU-8 capillary between iterations.

golden_gate.additional_reagent: T4 DNA ligase 2.5 U/uL + 0.05% Pluronic F-127

cross_contamination.strategy: HFE 7500 biocompatible oil + 0.05% w/v Pluronic F-127 surfactant additive (no wash steps)
cross_contamination.validation: 30 colonies picked from pProm1_BCD2-gfp plate; all 30 showed BCD2 banding pattern (Fig 4c); statistical analysis in Supporting Information

automation_system.feedback: Impedance sensing; Vsense threshold ~0.15 V for ~0.2 uL droplets
automation_system.software: In-house automation; controls droplet movement, feedback sensing, syringe pumps, valves, Peltier, function generator (Fig S3)
